posts.title: sonic: the cost of sounds nobody hears
posts.description: say there are 10,000 sounds on an RPG battlefield and room to mix 64. what happens to the other 9,936? a footstep might be over before anyone gets near it. a generator is different. if i walk up to it a second later, i want to hear a generator that’s already running, not one that starts because i showed up. so i built Sonic, a small Rust engine, to see if i could get that behavior without ticking
